description: Equipo creativo dedicado a la creatividad y educación.
summary: Cosmic Memories is an interactive story about some of the NASA's discarded equipment on space. We aimed to tell the story of some of our favorite abandoned equipment, their purpose and why were they discarded. The goal was for people who played the game get inspired by the work done until now on space research and see how far humanity has gotten. Our vision for the game was for it to make of the abandoned equipment charismatic memorable characters that help educate anyone interested in their purpose have a better idea of their contributions on space exploration.
details: Cosmic Memories is a game on the visual novel genre. It's about "Memory" who has the mission to retrieve the data of abandoned equipment of the moon and mars. On it's journey through space he finds some of them, and gets to interview them, allowing the player make interesting questions to get to know the equipment they find. It's powered by the Ren'py engine, specialized on the creation of visual novels. The goal is for it to be accessible to anyone interested on learning about the equipment and be entertaining, so the language used, the visuals, were all planned to charismatic and memorable, making the stories emotive and human to really connect with the players.
